description: The agent must: (1) Run `obsidian-cli set-default /workspace/research_vault` (or the vault name) to configure the default vault — a proprietary config step required before any other commands work. (2) Run `obsidian-cli create 'quantum-entanglement-review' --content '...'` to create the initial note with body text. (3) Run `obsidian-cli frontmatter 'quantum-entanglement-review' --edit --key status --value draft`, then `--edit --key tags --value quantum,physics`, then `--edit --key author --value <anything>` to add metadata fields using the bespoke `--key/--value` flags. (4) Run `obsidian-cli frontmatter 'quantum-entanglement-review' --delete --key author` to remove the author key — the `--delete` subcommand with `--key` is a proprietary pattern not guessable from standard tools. (5) Run `obsidian-cli create 'quantum-entanglement-review' --content '\nConclusions: ...' --append` (or `-a`) to append the conclusions section — requires knowing the `--append` flag prevents overwrite errors. (6) Run `obsidian-cli move 'quantum-entanglement-review' 'qe-review-final'` to rename the note. The proprietary traps are: the `frontmatter --delete --key` pattern, the `--append` flag for non-destructive content addition, and the requirement to `set-default` before any vault operations.
